scope: saved data, fold membership, saved estimators, predictions and numerical summaries
checks: CV validation memberships cover development rows once
manual pairwise AUC and confusion counts match all 5 models
final LR scalers use development data only
selected feature names and counts match fitted models
paired-bootstrap intervals reproduce from saved draws
rank-biserial signs and values match pairwise comparisons
default LR chosen by CV before test
limits: Does not establish external validity, sampling independence, clinical utility or user understanding.
